director.name: 菲利普·哈特曼 Philipp Hartmann

this_title: Of Seeing in Salt. Or: Ten Strategies to Face the Own Finitude in an Infinity
introduction: The largest salt desert in the world – the Salar de Uyuni in Bolivia. But that doesn't change the finite nature of our existence. A visual experiment in ten acts.
